hud.essentialcraft5.armor_charge.desc.en: The MRU stored in the shield armor you're wearing, added together.
hud.essentialcraft5.armor_charge.desc.zh: 身上几件 MRU 护盾盔甲存的电合在一起算。

hud.essentialcraft5.armor_charge.desc.ch.en: Stand on top of your own Charging Chamber and it charges the pieces one at a time.
hud.essentialcraft5.armor_charge.desc.ch.zh: 站到自己的充能仓上面，它会轮流给这几件充电。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.armor_charge.ful.en: Full charge: about %2$s hits of %1$s damage
tooltip.essentialcraft5.armor_charge.ful.zh: 满电约挡：%s 点 × %s 下

tooltip.essentialcraft5.armor_charge.fre.en: Blocks hits at no MRU cost while it holds any charge
tooltip.essentialcraft5.armor_charge.fre.zh: 存着电就挡，挡伤害不耗电
